source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Briefly describe the scope of the audit, including the areas and procedures that were inspected.
3. Provide details of the findings.
     a. List the specific safety regulations and standards that were not met.
     b. Identify the exact locations and conditions that were found to be non-compliant.
     c. Include photographs or diagrams where possible.
4. Document the severity of the violations.
     a. Note the potential risks and hazards that could result from the non-compliance.
     b. Mention any immediate corrective actions that were recommended.
5. Include a timeline of events.
     a. Record the date(s) when the audit was conducted.
     b. List any verbal or informal warnings provided prior to the formal audit.
     c. Note the date when the audit report was issued.
6. Describe the communication process.
     a. Detail who was present during the audit, including the names and positions of auditors and company personnel.
     b.
